scope.interactionChannel: real macOS keyboard input via cliclick

observations.name: physical query entry
observations.detail: After a real Command-K opens Quick Switch, real OS typing of settings enters the focused input and filters the list to the single Open settings action.

observations.name: physical Escape dismissal
observations.detail: A real Escape key dismisses the focused Quick Switch overlay and restores the canonical thread view.

observations.name: physical ArrowDown navigation
observations.detail: On a fresh current-bundle process opened directly into the root palette, the input visibly has a caret but a real ArrowDown leaves the active highlight on the first row. Lynxtron does not deliver a usable input or container keydown event, matching the documented R5 runtime boundary.

classification.closedProductLoss: Opening Quick Switch now focuses its real Native input, so physical character entry filters the palette; physical Escape also dismisses the focused overlay.
remainingProductLoss: Physical ArrowUp, ArrowDown, and Enter navigation remain unavailable because Lynxtron does not deliver a usable renderer key event for the focused input or its container.
missingCoverage: Light-theme physical query entry was not repeated and receives no borrowed dark-theme credit.
The filtered Open settings action was not activated with Enter.
classification.harnessLoss: Desktop DevTool registration remains unavailable; exact-PID WindowServer frames, immutable snapshot identity, bundle hash, and process logs are used without claiming DevTool console or LynxView geometry evidence.
